/* master.mpif.selectMasterMpIfCowayDoctorAsList */
SELECT A.MBLNR, A.PERNR, A.DELDA, A.REPAIR_CODE, B.TEXT1 AS REPAIR_NAME, A.TOOL_NAME, A.MODEL_NAME, A.REPAIR_COST, A.INVOICE_NUM, A.BIGO, CASE WHEN A.BIGO IS NULL THEN '6' ELSE '5' END AS BIGO_IMG, CASE WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'S' THEN '전송완료' WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'E' THEN '전송오류' WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'N' THEN '전송대기' WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'T' THEN '임시저장' END AS IF_FLAG_TEXT, A.IF_FLAG, A.IF_MSG FROM COWAY_DOCTOR_AS A , ICOMCOD2 B WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.DELDA LIKE #{DELDA}||'%'
AND A.MBLNR LIKE #{st_mblnr}||'%'
AND A.PERNR LIKE #{st_pernr}||'%'
AND A.IF_FLAG = #{st_if_flag}
AND 'C008' = B.TYPE(+) AND A.REPAIR_CODE = B.CODE(+) AND 'KRCOWA0008' = B.COMPANY_CODE(+)
mapper.update: INSERT INTO COWAY_DOCTOR_AS ( MBLNR, PERNR, DELDA, REPAIR_CODE, TOOL_NAME, MODEL_NAME, REPAIR_COST, INVOICE_NUM, IF_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{MBLNR}, #{PERNR}, #{DELDA}, #{REPAIR_CODE}, #{TOOL_NAME}, #{MODEL_NAME}, #{REPAIR_COST}, #{INVOICE_NUM}, 'T' )
